runs.title: First radar: three official routes visible
runs.summary: Hedera, Cyfrin and Nexo visibly invite applications; reward and deadline gaps remain.

runs.title: Six open routes; a 30 Sep trading deadline
runs.summary: Aster, Elk and Nomis join the checked open table; Bitget’s distinct Trading Builder campaign is time-limited.

runs.title: Six routes remain; MetaMask has no confirmed public form
runs.summary: The established six routes remain; MetaMask’s official forum distinguishes a voluntary role from a currently confirmed public application.

runs.title: Soneium opens; Nexo route disappears
runs.summary: Soneium and Torium enter the open table from current issuer pages, while Nexo’s old ambassador path no longer provides a public route.

runs.title: Nexo’s form returns; Oasis and Fiber add routes
runs.summary: Nexo’s official page again shows its ambassador form, while Oasis and Fiber provide new issuer-linked routes with different payment and data conditions.

runs.title: Two application routes added; Torium’s first $100 threshold is 50K views
runs.summary: Bybit and HeLa enter the application table with distinct geography and reward terms; Torium’s stated threshold becomes explicit, while Pendulum and Wager Predict remain separate status calls.

runs.title: Cronos and Zerion routes added; terms and data cost remain open
runs.summary: Cronos and Zerion both link formal application routes, but the useful distinction is their missing work, reward, form-state and data conditions.

runs.title: Injective opens a route; Arc is not an application
runs.summary: Added Injective’s current issuer-linked Zealy route; separated Arc contribution and BNB’s expired old form from formal applications.

runs.title: Three routes added; none is a fixed pay offer
runs.summary: Stellar, Midnight and Thrilld have issuer or issuer-partner application calls, but their trial, volunteer and KPI-linked compensation terms require different decisions.

runs.title: Two routes added; one states €1,000 only after approved event delivery
runs.summary: MiCA adds a local professional event route with conditional €1,000 compensation and a separate proposed budget; Autheo adds five builder seats with a stated monthly workload but no published reward.

runs.title: PIVX form remains; its current payment budget does not
runs.summary: PIVX’s referral form remains visible, but a staff administrator says the Q3 programme was not approved and has no budget or allocated payment funds; its route now moves to not confirmed.

runs.title: HPP confirmation date, no public join route
runs.summary: Party Knights Cohort 2 remains held out because no formal approval result or public join route was displayed on its stated confirmation date.

runs.title: Sogo’s open route requires Tier 2 KYC before application
runs.summary: Added Sogo as a referral-commission route with the KYC, qualifying-transaction and vesting conditions visible before application.

runs.title: 21 routes rechecked; RabbitHole claim stays out
runs.summary: Eight issuer routes still display their prior action paths and terms. RabbitHole is held out because its reported issuer documentation could not be inspected.

runs.title: Bitget closes 30 Sep; the pool is shared
runs.summary: Bitget’s issuer page still lists a 30 Sep recruitment close, but its $50,000 promotion pool has no stated individual award and the work promotes trading products.

runs.title: XO Market claim held out
runs.summary: A community post claimed an open XO Market ambassador wave and USDC rewards, but an issuer post describes the program as invite-only; no current public route was inspected. Bitget still lists 30 Sep as its close.

runs.title: XO Market and Bitget: eligibility and award limits, 27 September 2026
runs.summary: The 27 September notes describe XO Market’s invite-only program and Bitget’s stated 30 September close, without establishing a current public application route or individual award.

runs.title: Bitget deadline rechecked; Zengo intake unconfirmed
runs.summary: Bitget still states a 30 Sep close and no individual award. Zengo invites volunteers but its linked form could not be inspected, so its intake remains unconfirmed.

runs.title: Cardano interest form is not a confirmed intake
runs.summary: Cardano’s issuer-linked form has no dated current selection window; Bitget still states 30 Sep, and Solana’s Spanish page still states a passed 1 Sep close.

runs.title: Aster route unverified; Bitget final published date
runs.summary: Aster moved out of the current-open list because its issuer page no longer exposed the application action. Bitget still states 30 Sep, without a closing hour or individual award amount.

runs.title: Bitget window ended; Aptos current intake unverified
runs.summary: Bitget’s published recruitment date passed. Aptos has a form but no verified current quarterly cohort window.

runs.title: Bit2Me intake unverified; payout asset conflict
runs.summary: A Bit2Me form remains linked but no current selection window was verified; its issuer pages disagree on the payment asset. Three existing open routes were rechecked.

runs.title: Three routes rechecked; Zerion form host moved
runs.summary: Nexo, MiCA Crypto Alliance and Zerion retain their listed status. Zerion’s hosted form moved to a new host that could not be inspected.

runs.title: Elk and Nomis routes rechecked
runs.summary: Elk and Nomis still link ambassador applications, but hosted-form acceptance was not verified; the 20-route total is unchanged.

runs.title: Polkadot’s old salary is not a current offer
runs.summary: A current roundup repeats a former 10,000 USDT Head Ambassador term; the successor Fellowship is not salaried by rank. Current intake was not verified; Hedera and Cyfrin were rechecked.

runs.title: Cardano project fund is not entrant pay
runs.summary: Cardano reported US$10,000 across eight approved ambassador projects, not a personal award for a new applicant; current public intake remains unverified.

runs.title: Stellar official intake and weekly duties
runs.summary: The issuer handbook links a program-wide form and specifies recurring community work; actual form acceptance and individual pay remain unverified.

runs.title: Tangem application invitation; commission rate unstated
runs.summary: Tangem publishes an Apply route and open-applications announcement, but no enhanced ambassador rate, fixed pay or inspectable form acceptance. The open-row count rises to 21.

runs.title: ChainGPT Council intake unverified
runs.summary: Automatic Buzz tiers are not a formal open application; Council applications use limited batches, with no current batch verified. Tangem still links Apply. The open-row count remains 21.

runs.title: Hedera and Cyfrin invitations rechecked
runs.summary: Both issuer pages still invite applicants; form acceptance and cash pay remain unverified.

runs.title: Action Model public post before selection
runs.summary: A visible application requires public promotion before selection while personal pay remains unstated; the dated open table rises to 22.

runs.title: Arxon applications closed; shared token pool is not personal pay
runs.summary: Indexed issuer text says closed despite a LIVE label; the token figure is a shared TGE-linked pool, not applicant pay.

runs.title: Kambria referral fees depend on qualified outcomes
runs.summary: The DEP 3 project call ends 31 Oct, but $10 and $20 USDT fees require shortlisting or selection; the separate CED route pays only after two sessions. Form state and payouts remain unverified.

runs.title: Soneium invitation rechecked; Bit2Me intake still unverified
runs.summary: Soneium still publishes an issuer invitation; Typeform acceptance was not visible. Bit2Me still lacks an October review window and settled payout asset. The core count remains 22.

runs.title: Hedera and Cyfrin invitations rechecked
runs.summary: Both issuer pages still invite applications; hosted form acceptance and individual cash pay remain unverified. Other rows retain earlier check dates.

runs.title: Vara application visible; rewards discretionary
runs.summary: Vara adds an issuer-linked on-site application first step for voluntary contributor work, with no stated personal reward rate. Soneium invitation persists; hosted form acceptance is unknown.

runs.title: Sogo referral route separated; Elk and HeLa rechecked
runs.summary: Sogo stays open by issuer statement but is referral-only; 22 contributor routes remain, with Elk and HeLa checked today.

runs.title: GoMining referral conditions separated from contributor routes
runs.summary: GoMining referral status depends on post-status users and qualifying purchases; the 22 contributor invitations retain older checks.

runs.title: Midnight Cohort 5 open; volunteer terms unchanged
runs.summary: Issuer-linked application landing names Cohort 5. The role is volunteer, and form fields, deadline and typical outcomes remain unverified.
